dataset_metadata.name: ARES-MED Specimen-Aware Point-of-Care Lab Reference Intervals & Alert Bands
dataset_metadata.source: Abbott i-STAT CG8+/CG4+ IFUs, ARUP Critical Values (Rev 47), Michigan Medicine, University Hospitals Dorset
dataset_metadata.description: Specimen-aware reference intervals, ARES warning bands, and institution-specific critical limits for Mode B lab orders and Dheer's diagnostic simulator. Never silently merge institution policies.

comparison_logic.pseudocode: if invalid_sample: status = 'unreliable' elif value meets critical_policy: status = 'critical' elif value outside specimen_reference: status = 'warning' else: status = 'within_reference'

device_capability_notes.i_stat_cg8_plus: Measures Na+, K+, iCa, Glucose, Hematocrit, and blood-gas variables; calculates HCO3- and Hemoglobin. Does NOT measure Chloride (Cl-) or full CBC (WBC, Platelets, ALC).
device_capability_notes.i_stat_cg4_plus: Measures blood gases (pH, pCO2, pO2) and Lactate; calculates HCO3-.
device_capability_notes.c2m2_note: C2M2 (Canadian Space Agency Connected Care Medical Module) is an integrated connected-care platform concept, not a single named CBC analyzer. CBC fields (WBC, Platelets, ALC) require a separate validated hematology analyzer.

blood_gas_and_lactate.ares_warning_rule: Outside selected specimen reference interval before critical limit
blood_gas_and_lactate.search_text: Lab pH i-STAT CG4+ CG8+ arterial 7.35-7.45 venous 7.31-7.41 critical <7.20 >7.60.

blood_gas_and_lactate.ares_warning_rule: Outside selected specimen reference interval before critical limit
blood_gas_and_lactate.search_text: Lab pCO2 i-STAT CG4+ CG8+ arterial 35-45 venous 41-51 mmHg critical <20 >65 hypercapnia.

blood_gas_and_lactate.provenance_note: Calculated on i-STAT from measured acid-base variables; treat calculated and measured values as distinct provenance types.

critical_limits.policy_source: ARUP total CO2 policy (example only; not manufacturer calculated-HCO3 standard)

blood_gas_and_lactate.search_text: Lab HCO3- bicarbonate calculated i-STAT arterial 22-26 venous 23-28 mmol/L.
Lab Lactate i-STAT CG4+ arterial 0.36-1.25 venous 0.90-1.70 mmol/L warning >1.70 critical >=5.0 sepsis shock trauma.

electrolytes_and_glucose.search_text: Lab Na+ sodium i-STAT CG8+ 138-146 mmol/L warning 120-<138 >146-160 critical <120 >160.
Lab K+ potassium i-STAT CG8+ 3.5-4.9 mmol/L warning 3.0-<3.5 >4.9-6.1 critical <3.0 >6.1.

cartridges: Separate Chemistry Panel (NOT on i-STAT CG8+)
electrolytes_and_glucose.search_text: Lab Cl- chloride 98-108 mmol/L warning 80-<98 >108-130 critical <80 >130 not on CG8+.
Lab iCa ionized calcium i-STAT CG8+ 1.12-1.32 mmol/L critical <=0.78 >=1.58.
Lab Glucose i-STAT CG8+ 70-105 mg/dL warning 55-<70 >105-450 critical <55 >450.

hematology_cbc.instrument_note: Requires validated hematology analyzer (NOT supplied by i-STAT CG8+)
hematology_cbc.search_text: Lab WBC white blood cell count 4.0-10.0 x10^9/L critical <=2.0 >=40.0 infection sepsis appendicitis.

hematology_cbc.instrument_note: Requires validated hematology analyzer (NOT supplied by i-STAT CG8+)
hematology_cbc.search_text: Lab Platelets 150-410 x10^9/L critical <=20 >=1000 ARS thrombocytopenia hemorrhage lockout.

hematology_cbc.instrument_note: Calculated from Hematocrit on i-STAT CG8+, or measured directly on hematology analyzer. Acute hemorrhage may lag.
hematology_cbc.search_text: Lab Hemoglobin Hb g/dL male 13-17 female 12-15 critical <7.0 hemorrhage anemia.

hematology_cbc.instrument_note: Requires validated hematology analyzer with leukocyte differential (NOT supplied by i-STAT CG8+)
hematology_cbc.ares_warning_rule: Outside selected local interval; track serial exponential depletion N(t)=N0*exp(-k(D)*t) post-SPE
hematology_cbc.search_text: Lab ALC Absolute Lymphocyte Count 1.0-3.0 1.5-3.5 x10^9/L ARS biodosimetry radiation depletion.
